facts.fact: The national cybersecurity strategy (final version dated 15 December 2023) lists among the country's milestones that the Quadro Nacional de Interoperabilidade was published in November 2021.
The same strategy states that a Lei de Interoperabilidade was at the time a draft bill (Projeto de Lei); no date is given for the draft, so the strategy's 2023-12-15 date is used.
